Article: (CNN)They are very convincing when they call. They have a Washington phone number and can cite your financial history down to the cent. They say you're under investigation, in danger of losing your home, or worse, your freedom -- unless you pay thousands of dollars on the spot. But they're not real.

Summary: IRS scam has swindled victims out of more than $15 million since 2013 .
Scammers warn of seizing property, prison time .
FTC and Treasury department have open investigations .
